subject.title: Dashboard: preview widget — live URL embed, dev-server preview, browser-backed inspection

question: Should this preview widget be accepted as trusted bundled dashboard work now, and what security boundary should Phase 1 use before dev-server and browser-inspection follow-ups?
rationale: The request is not a narrow bug fix: it asks OpenClaw to expose trusted embeds now and later spawn processes plus read browser console/network/screenshot state, which automation cannot safely scope without maintainer product and security intent.

options.title: Approve read-only Phase 1
options.body: Add only the trusted URL preview widget with reload and viewport chrome, using existing embed sandbox/external-URL policy and leaving dev-server/browser inspection to separate follow-ups.

options.title: Fold into browser preview track
options.body: Route this through the broader browser-preview and login-handoff design so the widget shares one security model with the visible browser panel work.

options.title: Wait for dashboard substrate
options.body: Keep the issue open but defer implementation until the open Modular Dashboard base PRs land and the widget API is stable.

recommendation.title: Approve read-only Phase 1
recommendation.body: Add only the trusted URL preview widget with reload and viewport chrome, using existing embed sandbox/external-URL policy and leaving dev-server/browser inspection to separate follow-ups.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete has the strongest combined signal from the merged plugin-tab seam, browser/gateway routing history, and related browser-preview triage comments.
